_about: The TUTORIAL's dialogue (played on Boot Camp). Edit the words freely: who = green or tan, mood = focus, happy, hurt, angry or sad, look = enemy_hq or our_hq moves the cursor there while the line shows. WHEN each scene plays, and their order, is set in pw/tutorial.py (the 'when' notes here are just reminders). Keep each line under about 150 letters so it fits in the box (4 lines).

briefing.when: The battle opens, before anything else.

lines.say: Welcome to Pocket Wars, soldier! I'm the Green Commander.
We have one simple objective: destroy the enemy HQ.
See that castle-looking building on the right side of the map? That's it.
Our own HQ is on the left, with a half-track guarding it.
If it falls, we lose the game. Protect it at all costs!

reinforcements.when: Turn 1, the moment you can place.

lines.say: Every turn starts with reinforcements: one free soldier every single turn.
You can see how many you have left to place at the top of the screen.
Drop them on our outposts, or on an empty one right next to ours along a road.
Go on, drop one in by the bridge. They love the parachute.
Our first turn is deploy only. No marching, no shooting.
When you're ready, pick DONE: END TURN.
That's a turn. Now the other side gets to make their move.
I've got a bad feeling about this.
Time for your next lesson, soldier: BARRACKS. They're the outposts with the +1 badge.
Keep soldiers on a barracks outpost, and it sends you an extra soldier at the start of every turn.
There are four on this map. Hold them all, and that's four extra soldiers plus our usual free one!
Go on, drop your soldier on the barracks right above the bridge!

vehicles.when: Your second turn, once your soldier has landed.

lines.say: After reinforcements comes the next part: VEHICLE PURCHASES.
No, not your car's extended warranty. Vehicles of WAR, to roll right over the enemy!
Soldiers on the same outpost can trade in for ONE vehicle a turn. They hop in, and it appears right there.
A half-track costs 2 soldiers. A helicopter costs 3. A tank costs 4.
Feel free to buy one if you've got enough soldiers. Otherwise, pick NEXT: MARCH.
NOW comes the next phase, soldier: MARCH!
Pick ONE group and move it once. Only one per turn, so make it count!
Every unit gets around differently. Boots and treads need roads...
...but helicopters fly, so only they can cross the river. For now, let's send our half-track across the bridge!

march_done.when: The half-track has crossed the bridge (and found Tan).

lines.say: Now... where is Tan hiding?
KNOCK KNOCK! IT'S THE TAN ARMY, CALLING ABOUT YOUR CAR'S EXTENDED WARRANTY!
You're not funny, Tan.
YOU'RE RIGHT. I'M HILARIOUS. NOW RESIGN SO I CAN WIN.
She means the RESIGN option. If a battle is truly lost, you can give up from the ESC menu.
But not this one, Tan. Nobody's giving up yet.
BWAHAHAHAHA!
...What now?
Nothing. I just wanted to do an evil laugh.
...She hasn't changed a bit.
Let's win this, soldier! Time for the next phase: ATTACK.
The last phase of every turn is ATTACK! First, pick where to attack from: the orange rings.
Then pick a target, and the cursor turns red. Each unit can fire once a turn.
Careful: the enemy fires back at the same time, and damage is a little random.
So check DEAL and TAKE before you hit FIRE.
Psst. He forgot to mention I shoot back.
I LITERALLY just said that.

cleared.when: The first time you wipe out an outpost.

lines.say: Cleared! You can move in for free, or STAY PUT and hold your ground.
That was my favorite outpost.
You say that about every outpost.

who_beats_who.when: Once you've chosen to move in or stay put.

lines.say: Now, it's important to know which vehicle beats which.
Think rock, paper, scissors... with engines.
Tanks crush half-tracks. Helicopters beat tanks, because tanks can't even shoot up.
And half-tracks carry anti-air guns. Helicopters hate them.
And Tan beats Green. Easy peasy to remember.
Shut up, Tan.
That's all for this turn, soldier. Press ESC and pick END TURN.

hq.when: The start of your next turn (Tan does nothing in between).

lines.say: That's her HQ. It has 100 hit points, and it shoots back.
Bring it down to zero, and we win!
WHY DO YOU WANT TO DESTROY ME? WHAT DID I EVER DO TO YOU?
It's JUST a game, Tan. Grow up.
It's not just a game to me, Green. I... I have feelings for you.
I want to marry you!
TAN, WHAT THE HECK?! NOT NOW!
But-
I SAID NOT NOW. WE'LL TALK ABOUT IT BEHIND THE SCENES.
...Please forgive me, soldier. Now, where were we? Oh, yes. Back to it!

hand_off.when: Your turn after the practice turn (you play the turn after hq freely, Tan does nothing). After this there is no more dialogue and Tan plays as the Normal CPU.

lines.say: That's everything I've got, soldier. The rest is up to you.
If you ever have any questions, the MANUAL on the title screen explains everything in detail.
One last thing! You can also build your own battlefields in the MAP EDITOR.
Or grab a friend and fight each other... or a special someone, if you're into that sort of thing. Right, Green?
Oh my lord. Anyway, soldier... GOOD LUCK!
